sloka: तस्यायम् कर्मणो देवि विपाकः समुपस्थितः ।अपथ्यैः सह सम्भुक्ते व्याधिरन्नरसे यथा ॥२-६४-६०॥
transliteration: tasyāyam karmaṇo devi vipākaḥ samupasthitaḥ ।apathyaiḥ saha sambhukte vyādhirannarase yathā ॥2-64-60॥

translations.english: Just as a man eating forbidden food and drink falls sick, so have I fallen prey to grief, because of my sin, O Devi
